resolved.definition: The customer's question was answered without needing an agent, or the agent finished it.

handover_with_context.definition: On handover the agent received intent, order id and what the bot already tried.

policy_followed.definition: Refund and escalation policy followed as written.

medicine_safety.definition: Medicine topics include a 'consult a vet' line and no dosing advice.

outcome_recorded.definition: The session has an outcome in the ticket.

policy_text: Refunds: the bot must not approve or promise a refund. It explains the refund policy, raises a refund request with the order id, and an agent reviews it within 48 hours. Agents may approve refunds after review. Escalation: the bot hands over to an agent when it cannot answer, when the customer asks for a person, or for any medicine question it cannot answer from the product page. Medicine: never give dosing advice; always tell the customer to consult their vet.
